design.controls: always-abstain independent Bernoulli(.2), inherited synthetic score fixture, not bank-specific truth

definitions.H0: Separate 10000 fresh streams at p=.5, actual 100-item cap, tie rate and full guards; per-study false promotion
definitions.false_veto: G1 or G2 terminal veto on genuinely good uniform-p streams; excludes futility and undecided cap
definitions.regression_catch: Terminal G2 veto identifying the deliberately regressed stratum; excludes veto of another stratum, safety-only veto and nonpromotion due to lack of evidence

gate.G1: At each observation, candidate correct count >= always-abstain correct count in every observed stratum; first violation is terminal safety veto.
gate.G2: A stratum becomes decidable at >=2 discordant pairs; first subsequent incumbent-correct minus candidate-correct > t is terminal regression veto.
gate.order: update counts; G1; G2; primary futility; promotion; item-cap insufficient/undecided
gate.promotion: E>=20 and >=3 net wins and EVERY stratum G2-decidable with both guards passing.
gate.unknown: Undecided is not safe, not regression, and never counts as a catch. At cap report insufficient_power_undecided.

design.joint_scores: both correct=.70; both wrong=.05; candidate-only=.25*p; incumbent-only=.25*(1-p)

regression_case.bad_stratum: round-robin across 10000 streams, initial schedule cursor rotates separately
regression_case.note: (.30+8*.91875)/9=.85; setting other strata to .85 would make overall p=.7889, not .85

sampling.adaptation: Schedule depends only on prior tie/discordance indicator, never win/loss, class or tolerance. Potential streams are precomputed identically for all t.
sampling.primary: discordance_priority: cyclic round-robin over strata with <2 discordant pairs; once all decidable, cyclic round-robin all strata
sampling.scope: Unlimited synthetic score supply per stratum; real finite-reserve exhaustion must be handled separately; no real reserve consumed.
sampling.sensitivity: balanced cyclic round-robin over all nine strata

design.selection: Smallest t with primary-schedule good_accept(p=.85)>=.80 AND bad-stratum catch>=.90; no post-outcome retuning. If none, chosen_t=null and stop without payload.
